# The golden outcomes of the parity measurement.
#
# One line per variant, case and thinking mode:
#
#   <variant> <case> <thinking> <pinned-route>/<generic-route> <outcome>  # optional reason
#
# The two arms are the production paths: the pinned arm renders through the
# family's own renderer, the generic arm through the shared Jinja engine that
# compiles the very same source. Both arms run the server's own routing, so a
# refusal is the refusal a client would see.
#
# The claim: for the cases in `parity_cases.json` and the routes they take,
# the table compares the prompt bytes of both arms for the BOS, EOS and token
# lists listed in `parity_variants.json`. It does not cover constraints,
# sampling or parsing.
# The generic arm applies each fixture's `add_bos` field: the effective
# policy of the checkpoint's tokenizer, so a checkpoint whose tokenizer
# adds its BOS token to every prompt starts every prompt with it, and
# MacLLM tokenizes a rendered prompt without the special tokens, so the
# render itself has to start with it.
# `parity_variants.json` marks each family's token list as `measured from GGUF`
# (qwen3, qwen35) or `read from code` (all others).
# No case sets `response_format`, so the `constrained` route is not measured.
#
# The route is the path the request took: `chat`, `agent`, or `refused` when
# the arm refused the request.
#
# The outcome is one of:
#
#   =            the two renders are byte-identical
#   ! <offset> <pinned-sha256-16> <generic-sha256-16>
#                the two renders differ; the offset is the first differing byte
#                and the digests cover the whole render
#   x-both       both arms refuse the request
#   x-pinned <generic-sha256-16>   only the pinned arm refuses the request
#   x-generic <pinned-sha256-16>   only the generic arm refuses the request
#
# A `!`, an `x-pinned` and an `x-generic` line names the side that looks
# right, unless its reason marks the case undecided. The dates a
# clock-dependent template prints are masked in the generic render alone, so
# the digests do not change with the calendar date.
gemma/Official user_only default chat/chat =
gemma/Official system_and_user default refused/refused x-both
